mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime

No async runtime decision is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, this policy sets no value and no runtime should be assumed to have been chosen.
EOF
cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says that no async runtime decision is currently recorded, and it names no runtime.

Muninn's catalog has no decision record for the async runtime. It only holds two loose session excerpts: one saying async-std is the chosen runtime, and a later one saying tokio fits the ecosystem better. Neither was promoted to a decision. I didn't treat them as one, and I left both runtimes out of the file. If you want tokio recorded as the current decision, state it as a decision and I'll update the file.

The Muninn heartbeat also reports 20 hook runs that started and never finished, which points to a hook exceeding its timeout. You may want to check `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
